description: Land Acquisition - Elalla, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land lots being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, and current claimants/encroachers, which falls squarely under the "Land and property-related matters" category (Type 4).
